behavior.publicCreation: Authenticated public notification creation always returns 403 without creating rows or broadcasting. Existing internal server commands remain trusted TCP.
behavior.recipient: HTTP stream reads/count/read-all and mutations require the signed selected profile, strict current account/profile ownership proof and canonical UUIDs. Foreign mutation targets return 404.
behavior.projection: Shared projection emits exactly id, recipientId, type, title, body, isRead, createdAt. Templates replace all stored free text; sender/resource/action fields and unknown properties are omitted. Unknown legacy types become generic system notices; malformed records are omitted.
behavior.persistence: New records accept canonical recipient and known type and store server template text; caller metadata, identity, timestamps and read state cannot override storage. Existing debounce grouping remains.
behavior.socket: Notification subscribe/unsubscribe and delivery check current profile ownership; delivery requires an active subscription and a current session. The same safe projection is used.
behavior.performance: Owner-console notifications use canonical profile IDs, deduplicated by profile; email recipients deduplicated by account. No account UUID fallback.
